researchConclusion: Bounded public checks did not yield usable distinct dealer artwork. Generic text banners or unavailable image-host URLs do not prove that the dealer has no logo. This artwork is clearly an independent proposal.

generation.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one clean professional transparent automotive logo. Exact wordmark ADMIL CARS. The first word has FIVE letters: A D M I L, with only ONE I. Wide lockup: isolated compact geometric A at left, a generous transparent gap, and ADMIL large with CARS on a second line. Navy #0e253d, burgundy #8f2d45 and white. The A emblem has a single burgundy diagonal stripe. Use bold simple sans-serif custom letters, no tiny details. The entire design has crisp perfectly smooth dark navy and white double outlines so it is readable on white, charcoal and red backgrounds. Flat graphic, no gradients, no texture, no glow, no shadows, absolutely no speckles or distressed edges. Transparent background with clean antialiasing. Proposal, not dealer-approved. Correct literal spelling ADMIL, not ADMIIL.
